The inherited closed-domain interface is EXCESS for the unrestricted source Anchor, which remains open. Properness and whole-domain support availability restrict the loss interface; actual played legality suffices for the ambient comparison without learner feasibility. Feasible learner and admissible losses at t<T justify provider adapters and exclude the canonical zero fallback on that prefix. A,p are fixed deterministic functions without external independence or measurable/executable implementation claims. The transferred hB covers every vector sequence and feasible comparator for the same learner at the given T; B may depend on the full sequence and may be negative. Real loss interpretation follows finiteness proofs before toReal. Source1..T is Lean0..T-1; T0 is an empty-sum extension. No numerical rate for arbitrary learners, universal optimality, unrestricted source closure, chapter/book completion, purification or Exposition Seal is asserted.
